kit.name: TimelineShots
kit.doc: Plays every shot of the timeline with its component, plus the master audio. Unknown ids render a red warning card.

kit.name: timelineDuration
kit.doc: Total duration helper for <Composition durationInFrames={...}>.

kit.name: Captions
kit.doc: TikTok-style captions: the word being spoken, big and centered, popping in on each word.

kit.name: Sfx
kit.doc: Extra one-off sound inside a shot, when you can't rebuild the master (prefer "sfx" cues in script.json).

kit.name: Camera
kit.doc: * Virtual camera for a whole shot: slow push-in, optional drift, optional impact shakes. hits = frames (relative to the shot) where a shake impulse fires.

kit.name: Parallax
kit.doc: Parallax layer: moves `depth` × the camera pan. depth 0 = static, 1 = full.

kit.name: Tilt3D
kit.doc: 3D tilt-in of a card/scene (AE 3D layer with camera).

kit.name: CUT_EASE
kit.doc: Linear is not offered on purpose: linear transitions read as mechanical.

kit.name: CUT_FRAMES
kit.doc: Default frames: 6–16 for "invisible" transitions; longer only for drama.

kit.name: CUT_MOTION_BLUR
kit.doc: Moving transitions get motion blur by default (whip, zoom, split, depth already include it).

kit.name: transition
kit.doc: Build a transition. Returns null for "cut" (no overlap: a clean cut needs nothing).

kit.name: pickTransition
kit.doc: Choose a transition from shot energy, BPM and intent — the clean cut first, effects only when motivated.

kit.name: rampFrame
kit.doc: Remapped source frame for a shot whose last `n` frames ramp speed 100% → `low` (S-curve), or first `n` frames `low` → 100%.

kit.name: SpeedRampCut
kit.doc: Speed-ramp cut: A slows to `low` (40–50%) into the cut, B starts at `low` and ramps back to 100%. Shots must be frame-driven components (or <OffthreadVideo>).

kit.name: GooDefs
kit.doc: Mount once: SVG "goo" filter used by MorphText / fluid shapes.

kit.name: MorphText
kit.doc: Fluid text morph: letters of `from` melt into `to` (blur + alpha threshold). Text must be a solid color.

kit.name: snapToBeat
kit.doc: Snap a frame to the nearest beat frame (beats from tools/beats.py or beatFrames()).

kit.name: prog
kit.doc: 0→1 progress of an animation that starts at `start` and lasts `dur` frames.

kit.name: pop
kit.doc: Springy 0→1 (overshoots when damping is low).

kit.name: envelope
kit.doc: Enter + hold + exit envelope: 0→1 over `inDur`, holds, 1→0 over `outDur` ending at `end`.

kit.name: beatFrames
kit.doc: Frames per beat for a given BPM. Place cuts on multiples of this.

kit.name: EDIT_TIMING
kit.doc: Measured in the reference edits (tools/transscan.py + deep pass, 840 events / 27 edits). Frames at the edit's fps.

kit.name: flashCurve
kit.doc: Brightness of the measured flash at frame f for a cut at `at` (0..1). `len` stretches the tail.

kit.name: BloomFlash
kit.doc: Whiteout bloom flash on a hit. Default = the measured curve (starts 2 frames before `at`, peak -1..0, 8-frame tail); pass up/down for a custom triangle.

kit.name: HitShake
kit.doc: Wrap content: on each hit, shake with directional motion blur for `len` frames (the edit "hit shake").

kit.name: ZoomPunch
kit.doc: Zoom punch on hits: scale pops to `peak` and eases back over `len` frames.

kit.name: InvertFlash
kit.doc: 1–2 inverted frames on a hit. Wrap content.

kit.name: Strobe
kit.doc: Background strobe: alternates colors every `every` frames (red ↔ white edit look).

kit.name: Threshold
kit.doc: Hard black/white threshold of the content (cut-out silhouette look). Use over a <Strobe> with mixBlendMode multiply.

kit.name: Mirror
kit.doc: Mirror / kaleidoscope: 2 (left-right) or 4 copies.

kit.name: PixelStreak
kit.doc: Vertical pixel-sort streaks over the content for `dur` frames from `at`.

kit.name: Halation
kit.doc: Halation: highlights bloom and subjects get a soft outer glow (anime edit look). Wrap content.

kit.name: FlickerTitle
kit.doc: Title whose letters flicker on one by one (`S P A C E`).

kit.name: PercentCounter
kit.doc: Edit progress counter "37%" in a corner.

kit.name: BlackDip
kit.doc: Black dip: `frames` black frames right before `at` (before the final drop / ending).

kit.name: hitEnvelope
kit.doc: Quick helper: 0→1 envelope on hit frames (for driving any prop).

kit.name: EditCam
kit.doc: Camera life of a shot right after an edit cut (measured): "creep" pushes in +5 % accelerating, "settle" lands punched in and eases out, "punch" = big settle (1.5x -> 1x). Plus a hit shake that decays over the shot. Wrap one shot; frames are shot-relative.

kit.name: Smear
kit.doc: Directional motion blur (AE "Directional Blur" / CC Force Motion Blur look). x/y = blur in px along each axis.

kit.name: Glow
kit.doc: Glow: stacked drop-shadows. Wrap text, shapes or images.

kit.name: Grain
kit.doc: Animated film grain overlay.

kit.name: DotGrid
kit.doc: Dot grid background (as in tech promos). Drifts slowly.

kit.name: Orb
kit.doc: Big soft colored glow blob (the red "light" behind text).

kit.name: Bokeh
kit.doc: Floating out-of-focus particles.

kit.name: LightStreak
kit.doc: Horizontal lens-flare streak that shoots open from the center (logo reveals).

kit.name: Sparks
kit.doc: Radial burst of spark lines at `delay` (impact / logo hit).

kit.name: Starburst
kit.doc: Comic starburst / explosion shape behind text.

kit.name: Shockwave
kit.doc: Expanding ring (impact / transition accent).

kit.name: Cube3D
kit.doc: CSS 3D cube with flat shading.

kit.name: Viewfinder
kit.doc: Camera viewfinder: corner brackets + REC dot.

kit.name: HudRing
kit.doc: HUD ring: tick marks circle that rotates, glowing core.

kit.name: Letterbox
kit.doc: Black bars for a cinemascope look.

kit.name: Flash
kit.doc: White (or any color) flash on a cut. Put at the start of the incoming shot.

kit.name: headAt
kit.doc: Tracked head centre (0..1) at composition frame f.

kit.name: HeadLock
kit.doc: * src: staticFile(...) of the video; track: JSON from headtrack.py; startFrom: video frame (composition fps) to start at. zoom: scale over "cover" (1 = video covers the frame). follow: 1 = head locked to the centre, 0.5 = halfway. mirror: neighbour tiles are flipped, so the edges meet without a seam (a reflected world instead of a copy). at: where the head is held, 0..1 of the composition (default centre).

kit.name: ZoomIn
kit.doc: Radial zoom-blur entrance: content rushes in from `from` scale with trailing echo copies (fake radial blur).

kit.name: WarpStreaks
kit.doc: Stars streaking out of a center point (warp speed).

kit.name: SpeedLines
kit.doc: Comic radial speed lines around the frame edge; flicker every 2 frames.

kit.name: Slash
kit.doc: Lightsaber slash: a glowing line that cuts across the frame at an angle.

kit.name: Pops
kit.doc: Small words popping in around the frame (e.g. "HA" "HA").

kit.name: ScrollStack
kit.doc: Vertical camera move through a tall stack of lines. `focus[i]` = frame when line i is centered.

kit.name: Wobble
kit.doc: Letters that keep wobbling independently (kinetic type).

kit.name: WeightShift
kit.doc: Cross-fade the same text between two font styles (e.g. black → thin) with a squash.

kit.name: Scatter
kit.doc: Letters fly apart with spin starting at `at`.

kit.name: MorphShape
kit.doc: Shape morph: circle → rounded square → rotated square, with ghost outlines.

kit.name: Filmstrip
kit.doc: Film strip with sprocket holes, frames scrolling horizontally, red marks inside.

kit.name: GlowPill
kit.doc: Glowing pill/button outline with a label (logo badge).

kit.name: CompGrid
kit.doc: After Effects composition background: gray, grid, rulers.

kit.name: TransformBox
kit.doc: AE transform/selection box with 8 handles drawn around children.

kit.name: LayerBars
kit.doc: AE layer panel: layer bars stacking in from below.

kit.name: KeyLanes
kit.doc: Rows of keyframe diamonds popping in, with a sweeping playhead.

kit.name: GraphCurve
kit.doc: Easing curve with bezier handles drawing itself (graph editor).

kit.name: EchoTower
kit.doc: Echo stack tilted in 3D and slowly rotating (tower of repeated words).

kit.name: DiagonalBand
kit.doc: Tilted color band sliding across with text on it.

kit.name: TerminalLine
kit.doc: Terminal-style line: "›_" chevron + typed word + cursor.

kit.name: GradientText
kit.doc: Text with gradient fill.

kit.name: Sparkle
kit.doc: Four-point sparkle star that spins and pulses.

kit.name: Ruler
kit.doc: Timeline ruler with ticks and a glowing playhead dot travelling from `from` to `to` (0..1).

kit.name: Bulb
kit.doc: Light bulb icon with rays (idea).

kit.name: RepeatStretch
kit.doc: One letter + a run of repeated letters that stretches out ("FUUUUU").

kit.name: ChatCard
kit.doc: Claude-style chat card that types a prompt and shows a thinking blur.

kit.name: LightSweep
kit.doc: Diagonal light sweep flash across the frame (transition accent).

kit.name: Chroma
kit.doc: Chromatic aberration: red/cyan copies offset by `amount` px along `angle` (deg). Use on fast moves.

kit.name: ChromaDefs
kit.doc: Mount once per composition: SVG filters used by <Chroma>.

kit.name: Exit
kit.doc: Shot exit over the last `frames` frames of a shot of length `dur` (and optional entrance over the first `inFrames`).

kit.name: TypeOn
kit.doc: Type-on with glitch: each char shows 1–2 random glyph frames before resolving. `perChar` frames per char.

kit.name: WireExtrude
kit.doc: Wireframe extrusion: outline text with N stacked outline copies receding (3D wire look).

kit.name: eta
kit.doc: Rolls a value upward over time (ETA counters going UP, like a never-ending render).

kit.name: Slide
kit.doc: Fast slide-in (default 5 f) with velocity-matched motion blur + RGB split — the default word entrance of kinetic edits.

kit.name: Grade
kit.doc: Color grade wrapper (CSS approximation of a LUT).

kit.name: LightLeak
kit.doc: Warm light leaks drifting across the frame (vlog, wedding).

kit.name: VHS
kit.doc: VHS tape look: chroma offset copies, tracking band, noise lines, REC/PLAY timestamp. Wrap the content.

kit.name: Flicker
kit.doc: Random brightness flicker (horror). Wrap the content.

kit.name: AnamorphicFlare
kit.doc: Anamorphic lens flare: blue horizontal streak + ghost orbs, sweeping across.

kit.name: ImpactFrame
kit.doc: 1–2 frame inverted impact frame (anime). Put on top; fires at `at`.

kit.name: ChapterCard
kit.doc: Chapter card: number + title, letter-spaced, fades through black.

kit.name: QuoteCard
kit.doc: Quote card with big quote mark and author line.

kit.name: KaraokeLine
kit.doc: Karaoke line: all words visible, highlight fills each word while it is sung. Words from timeline (frames relative to the shot).

kit.name: MemeCaption
kit.doc: Classic meme caption: Impact, white with black stroke, top and/or bottom.

kit.name: Wasted
kit.doc: "WASTED"-style ending: desaturate + slow zoom + big red word. Wrap the content.

kit.name: JPText
kit.doc: Vertical Japanese text column (anime / AMV).

kit.name: LowerThird
kit.doc: Lower third: accent bar + name + subtitle, slides in from the left.

kit.name: ProgressBar
kit.doc: Thin progress bar along the top/bottom edge for the whole shot (or composition).

kit.name: Ticker
kit.doc: News ticker: endless scrolling headlines in a bar.

kit.name: BreakingBanner
kit.doc: BREAKING NEWS banner that slams in.

kit.name: StepBadge
kit.doc: Step badge: big number in a circle + label (tutorial).

kit.name: HighlightBox
kit.doc: Pulsing highlight box around a region (px).

kit.name: Callout
kit.doc: Callout: curved arrow from a label to a point (px).

kit.name: ZoomTo
kit.doc: Zoom-to-detail: camera pushes into point (px) of the children between `at` and `at+dur`.

kit.name: StatCard
kit.doc: Stat card: label + big number counting up (gym, ad).

kit.name: TimerDisplay
kit.doc: Countdown/stopwatch display mm:ss.ff (gym timer).

kit.name: Hitmarker
kit.doc: Hitmarker: X flashes at a point with a tick (gaming). `at` = frame.

kit.name: KillFeed
kit.doc: Killfeed: entries slide in at the top-right at their frames.

kit.name: ComboCounter
kit.doc: Combo counter: "x3" pops bigger on each hit frame.

kit.name: PriceTag
kit.doc: Price tag with optional old price strike-through.

kit.name: CTAButton
kit.doc: CTA button that pops in, then pulses; optional press at `pressAt`.

kit.name: BeforeAfter
kit.doc: Before/after split with a moving divider. Pass two children.

kit.name: MapPin
kit.doc: Map pin dropping onto a point with a location label.

kit.name: DayCounter
kit.doc: "DAY 3" counter card.

kit.name: PiP
kit.doc: Picture-in-picture frame (reaction): rounded window with border and a name chip.

kit.name: CommentBubble
kit.doc: Viewer comment bubble popping in (reaction / stream overlays).

kit.name: MangaPanels
kit.doc: Manga panels: diagonal panels, each rendering `render(i)`.

kit.name: EmojiPop
kit.doc: Emoji accent popping at a frame.

kit.name: SlamText
kit.doc: Word slams in from big scale with blur, settles with a small overshoot. The kinetic-typography workhorse.

kit.name: WhipIn
kit.doc: Whip in from a side with directional motion blur proportional to speed.

kit.name: Letters
kit.doc: Per-letter stagger (AE Text Animator with Offset).

kit.name: Words
kit.doc: Per-word stagger. Words listed in `accent` get `accentStyle` (e.g. red).

kit.name: MaskReveal
kit.doc: Text rises from behind an invisible line (mask reveal).

kit.name: Typewriter
kit.doc: Typewriter with blinking cursor; words in `highlight` get a colored box (prompt-box look).

kit.name: Counter
kit.doc: Rolling number counter.

kit.name: Outline
kit.doc: Hollow outline text.

kit.name: Extrude
kit.doc: Fake 3D extrusion (stacked text-shadows). angle in degrees, depth in px.

kit.name: EchoStack
kit.doc: Echo stack: the same line repeated, fading out above/below (cascading "LAYERS / KEYFRAMES" look).

kit.name: Stretch
kit.doc: Horizontal stretch: letters start smeared wide and snap into place.

kit.name: Glitch
kit.doc: Glitch: RGB split + horizontal slice offsets in short bursts. `every` = frames between bursts.

kit.name: Highlight
kit.doc: Colored box that wipes in behind a word (highlighter / label).

kit.name: Underline
kit.doc: Underline that sweeps in.

kit.name: CheckerText
kit.doc: Text filled with a transparency checkerboard (the "RENDER" look).

kit.name: punch
kit.doc: Scale "punch" on a beat: 1 → peak → 1 over a few frames. Use on any element: style={{transform: `scale(${punch(frame, 30)})`}}.

kit.name: Fit
kit.doc: Text sized to fill `width` exactly (capped at `max` px). Needs @remotion/layout-utils and a loaded font.

kit.name: whip
kit.doc: Whip pan: both shots slide with heavy directional blur. direction = where the picture travels ("left" = new shot comes in from the right).

kit.name: zoomThrough
kit.doc: Zoom-through: outgoing shot flies into the lens, incoming grows from the center.

kit.name: slices
kit.doc: Incoming shot slides in as alternating horizontal slices.

kit.name: streak
kit.doc: Column/row streak: the picture stretches into motion-blurred bars and snaps back (kinetic trailer cut).

kit.name: zoomBlur
kit.doc: Radial zoom blur: outgoing rushes into the lens with echo trails, incoming lands from behind.

kit.name: PromptBox
kit.doc: Chat/prompt input that types itself, with highlighted keywords and a glowing send button.

kit.name: Timeline
kit.doc: After Effects-like timeline: tracks with keyframe diamonds and a moving playhead.

kit.name: RenderBar
kit.doc: Render progress bar with percent and ETA.

kit.name: NodeGraph
kit.doc: Node graph: cards connected by animated glowing cables with a traveling pulse.

kit.name: Cursor
kit.doc: Mouse cursor that travels through points (`at` must increase, 2+ points) and clicks at the ones marked.

kit.name: PlayerMock
kit.doc: Video player mock: frame with big play button and scrubbing progress.

cuts.use: rhythm and visual logic match — the default
time passed, emotion softened
same, hides the digital crossfade
100% → 103%: reads as an impulse, not a fade
circle / diagonal / panel, always with an edge stroke
a shape repeats across the cut (eye → moon)
a moving object carries the next shot (track matte)
warm/cool leak on the beat, energy drops
warm/cool leak on the beat, energy drops
energetic accent, RGB split + scanline burst
glitch + VHS + 1-frame invert on the hit
dust/sparks dissolve
organic fluid fill
kinetic split: the frame tears apart
2D/3D hybrid: back into depth, out of the screen
energy rises; motion blur built in
energy rises; motion blur built in
A blows out, B fades out of white
2–4 black frames
A blows out in 1 frame, optional pure-color hold (`props.hold`, `color`), B settles from overexposure
the 1–2 frames around the cut are negative + smeared
1–2 frames of 1-bit b/w on the cut
A shrinks to a point over a color, B pops in oversized with glow
hard cut, B lands at 140 % with radial blur and settles
B pushes A out (up/down/left/right) with motion blur
A breaks into blocks, B resolves out of them (`props.white` = out of white)
A collapses into a bright line, B opens out of it
palette rotates through the spectrum while B dissolves in
A/B/A/B flicker every 2 frames, lands on B
B appears as a rounded card and grows to full frame

themes.name: Clean Tech (Apple keynote)
themes.motion: slow, smooth. Ease-out bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), 20–30 frame entrances, blur 20px→0 on reveal, slow 1.05 push-in. No shake, no glitch.

themes.name: Neon Cyber
themes.paletteText: bg #0A0A14, surface #151528, text #E8E8FF, accent #00F0FF, accent2 #FF2BD6, accent3 #B4FF39
themes.motion: snappy (8–12 frame entrances), glow on text and lines, glitch/RGB-split on cuts, scanlines overlay, grid floor with perspective.

themes.name: Bold Promo / Sport
themes.motion: aggressive. Spring overshoot (damping 10), hard slides, camera shake on hits, speed ramps, text filling the whole frame, quick 4–6 frame cuts on beats.

themes.name: Swiss / Minimal Editorial
themes.motion: grid-based, mask reveals (text slides up from behind a line), linear-ish precise moves with Easy Ease, lots of whitespace, no glow.

themes.name: Luxury / Fashion
themes.fonts: Cormorant Garamond 600 italic / Raleway 400 tracking 0.2em caps
themes.motion: very slow (40–60 frame fades with blur), letter-by-letter opacity, thin gold lines drawing (trim path), grain 4 %.

themes.name: Retro Y2K / Vaporwave
themes.fonts: Rubik Mono One / Press Start 2P accents
themes.motion: bouncy springs, chrome/gradient text, rotating stars and shapes, VHS noise, chromatic aberration.

themes.name: Soft Gradient SaaS
themes.motion: floating blurred blobs (noise-driven drift), glassmorphism cards (backdropFilter: blur(20px), white 8 % bg, 1px white 15 % border), UI mockups sliding in with spring.

themes.name: Playful / Kids / Social
themes.motion: squash & stretch, big overshoot springs (damping 8), wiggle, pop-in scale 0 → 1.15 → 1, stickers with white outline.

themes.name: Dark Documentary / Cinematic
themes.motion: Ken Burns on photos (scale 1→1.15 + slight pan over 5 s), letterbox bars 2.39:1, slow fades through black, heavy grain 6 %, vignette.

themes.name: Terminal / Hacker
themes.motion: typewriter text (1 char per 1–2 frames) with blinking cursor, line-by-line reveals, subtle CRT flicker.

themes.name: Kinetic Red (tech trailer)
themes.paletteText: bg #0B0B0D / paper #F1F0EE / red #FF2A3D — shots flip hard between the three backgrounds. Text black on paper/red, white on dark.
themes.fonts: Archivo Black (huge, uppercase, -0.03em; for Russian text use Unbounded 900 or Dela Gothic One) + Oswald 700 (condensed lines) + Playfair Display italic (one soft accent line) + JetBrains Mono (UI/labels)
themes.motion: 4–24 frame shots, SlamText, Stretch, WhipIn, Glitch on cuts, camera hits, red Orb + DotGrid + Bokeh on dark shots, logo hit with LightStreak + Sparks + Flash, mock UI (prompt box, timeline, node graph, render bar). Reference: examples/KineticPromo.tsx.

themes.name: Brutalist Mono
themes.fonts: Archivo Black / Space Grotesk 500 / JetBrains Mono labels
themes.motion: hard cuts only, no easing on position (linear snaps), oversized type cropped by the frame, grid lines, numbers and labels everywhere, invert (black bg) every 4th shot.

themes.name: Acid Hype
themes.fonts: Unbounded 900 / Dela Gothic One for Cyrillic punch / Inter 600
themes.motion: very fast (4–8 frame beats), strobing color flips acid↔black, Stretch, EchoStack, starbursts, stickers with thick outlines, heavy camera shake on drops.

themes.name: Anime Impact
themes.fonts: Dela Gothic One (supports Cyrillic) / Russo One / Noto Sans JP for kana accents
themes.motion: speed lines (repeating-conic-gradient from center), impact frames (1–2 frames inverted colors), Starburst behind characters, Shockwave, zoom punches, freeze-frame + slow push.

changelog.body:
### Added
- `/ae-motion:head-lock`: keep a head in the centre of the frame. `tools/headtrack.py` finds every cut (1-frame impact inserts included), makes a sheet of each shot's middle frame with a 0..1 grid, then tracks one head box per shot (OpenCV TrackerMIL, forward and backward, smoothed inside the shot, never across a cut) → `head.json`. `<HeadLock>` (`kit/headlock.tsx`) moves the video so the head stays centred and tiles it, plain or mirrored, so the picture wraps around the edges instead of showing black. Works on live action, cartoons and anime (nothing is auto-detected). Self-test: `python tools/headtrack.py --selftest`.

### Added
- `/ae-motion:doctor` + `tools/doctor.py`: read-only environment check (Python packages, Node.js, optional tools, Remotion add-ons, whether `src/kit/` matches the plugin's kit, `tsconfig` JSON imports, and a **Remotion version below 4.0.410**, which has critical advisories GHSA-2jqp-f4gr-44fr and GHSA-g6pc-6676-c23j).
- Hook (PreToolUse on Bash): `yt-dlp`, and `curl`/`wget` that write a file, now ask the user first. Off switch: `AE_MOTION_ALLOW_DOWNLOADS=1`.
- Agent `frame-reviewer`: reviews key-frame stills against the brief and `timeline.json` in its own context, read-only.
- `tools/requirements.txt` and `tools/requirements-extra.txt` (the README had missed `faster-whisper`, `opencv` and `yt-dlp`).
- CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): plugin validation, Python self-tests on 3.10 and 3.13, generated-file freshness, strict TypeScript check of the kit against Remotion 4.0.537, docs ↔ code consistency, gitleaks, pip-audit, npm audit.
- Site: catalog of the whole plugin (modes, components, transitions, sound with playable previews, themes, fonts, commands), the samples in the ae-motion house style, Russian/English interface, a start tab with install, update, FAQ and this changelog.
- `SECURITY.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, PR and issue templates; manifest `author`, `homepage`, `repository`, `keywords`.

### Fixed
- `examples/EditCuts.tsx` and `examples/PlanTest.tsx` imported `./kit` while the other examples import `../kit`; all now use `../kit`.
- Dead code in `tools/build.py` and `tools/transplan.py`.

### Added
- Motion lexicon: 144 motion names from [motion-prompt](https://github.com/showheyohtaki/motion-prompt) (MIT) mapped to kit components, with Russian names, energy and fitting modes; `tools/lexicon.py find|show`; `/ae-motion:lexicon`; gallery site in `docs/`.
- Brief before building (`references/brief.md`): Claude restates the task and asks one round of one-click questions.
- `/ae-motion:help`.

### Breaking
- The nine `trans-<kind>` commands were merged into one `/ae-motion:transition <kind>`.

  | Before | Now |
  |---|---|
  | `/ae-motion:trans-clean …` | `/ae-motion:transition clean …` |
  | `/ae-motion:trans-dissolve …` | `/ae-motion:transition dissolve …` |
  | `/ae-motion:trans-wipe …` | `/ae-motion:transition wipe …` |
  | `/ae-motion:trans-glitch …` | `/ae-motion:transition glitch …` |
  | `/ae-motion:trans-morph …` | `/ae-motion:transition morph …` |
  | `/ae-motion:trans-speedramp …` | `/ae-motion:transition speedramp …` |
  | `/ae-motion:trans-beat …` | `/ae-motion:transition beat …` |
  | `/ae-motion:trans-edit …` | `/ae-motion:transition edit …` |
  | `/ae-motion:trans-random …` | `/ae-motion:transition random …` |

  `/ae-motion:trans-plan` and `/ae-motion:trans-learn` are unchanged. The behaviour of each kind is the same text as before, now one section of `commands/transition.md`.
- Transition grammar measured in real edits and the planner `tools/transplan.py` (`/ae-motion:trans-plan`).
- Edit-staple transitions learned from 28 reference edits (`kit/editfx.tsx`, `tools/transscan.py`, `/ae-motion:trans-learn`).
- Online SFX by default, audio files as cues, edit-from-track example.
- SFX engine (`tools/sfxgen.py`, `tools/audit.py`), online music search, lessons from 28 TikTok edits.
- 18 slash-command modes with JSON presets, mode kit, music styles, `tools/transcribe.py`.
- One-command voice + sound engine (`tools/build.py`), fast-cut kit, reference trailer.
- Word-synced voice-over, procedural sound design, kinetic kit.
- Director mode, component kit, themes; 0.2.1 verified kit renders and added the Showcase example.
- First version: After Effects-style motion design skill for Remotion.
